readingLimits: No source was read end to end. All 30 research abstracts were read completely; 14 papers also have targeted body or typeset-method reading.

The initial official capture-log race was repaired with separate registries and a fresh official fetch. Excluded initial bodies have no invented retrieval-time receipt.
